description:
One SAM.gov contract notice as SpendQuery's brief sees it, no AI: the decision card (what
    the buyer needs, blockers, unknowns, a next step; each line labelled record / files /
    unknown), the timeline of the buy (planned buy, the contract it follows, earlier and newer
    notices, the award and the contract it became, each link confirmed / likely / possible) and
    what changed between versions of its public files. notice_id: from run_plan lists of
    contract_opportunities, or the id in a SAM.gov notice URL.

notice_id.description: A SAM.gov notice id: the 32-character hex id in a SAM.gov notice URL (sam.gov/opp/<id>/view) or from run_plan's contract_opportunities rows, e.g. "0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9".
notice_id.title: Notice Id
